body.objective: Compare Candidate A and Candidate B on one frozen cylinder fixture and select exactly one receiver-valid changed theory, or certify that neither minimal repair passes.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal Candidate A and Candidate B artifacts by exact commit, action and certificate hashes. Normalize both to the same cylinder geometry, coupling and clock conventions and print a side-by-side machine-readable matrix for seven gates: (1) complete action-derived BV rows with CME and Q^2=0; (2) elimination or controlled replacement of the compact-support class [u]; (3) complete support-local retarded/advanced causal parent; (4) cyclicity and reduced-pairing audit; (5) no new negative scalar or uncontrolled topological direction; (6) preservation or exact reclassification of the zero-charge D-gauge sector; and (7) compatibility with the healthy Berger clock. Candidate A fails if its scalar is negative, nonhyperbolic or destroys the charge restriction. Candidate B fails if its constraint is not locally causal, removes the physical clock or leaves an uncontrolled global three-form mode. Select A, B or NEITHER using only these gates, freeze the selected action and carrier hashes, and emit a strict consumer contract naming every changed equation, field and lifecycle. If both pass, select the smaller theory only after proving observational and charge equivalence on the declared fixtures; otherwise report the unresolved discriminator rather than averaging the theories.
body.current_gate: single fail-closed action-selection verdict from the common seven-gate cylinder comparison
body.forbid: no comparison across different conventions or quotient stages; no partial score or subjective preference used as a pass; no silent hybrid of A and B; no downstream q2, regulator, Einstein or observer construction before a selected action hash exists; no claim that either repair is strict pure Weyl gravity; no particle, scattering or unitarity claim
body.resource_hint: SELECTION GATE. It must remain non-READY until both independent candidate items terminate successfully enough to compare. Its output is the only authority for downstream changed-action work.
notes: The comparison is a theorem gate, not a planning poll.
NEITHER is a valid and important scientific verdict.
Every downstream receiver must verify the exact selected-action hash.
